<script>
/* turn ON the dark/white loading state immediately (html is available here) */
document.documentElement.classList.add('mn-preload');

(function () {
  var SID = '6a26fce5898c85354ee3b85b';
  var poll = setInterval(function () {
    var hero = document.querySelector('section[data-section-id="' + SID + '"]');
    if (hero && hero.querySelector('.mn')) {
      /* finished hero is in: hand the header to your footer's own styling, drop the loading state */
      document.body.classList.add('mn-hero-top');
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('mn-preload');
      clearInterval(poll);
    }
  }, 150);

  /* safety net: if nothing builds within 6s, reveal the raw lists rather than leave blanks */
  setTimeout(function () {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('mn-preload');
    clearInterval(poll);
    var hero = document.querySelector('section[data-section-id="' + SID + '"]');
    if (hero && !hero.querySelector('.mn')) {
      var l = hero.querySelector('.user-items-list'); if (l) l.style.display = '';
    }
    var book = document.querySelector('#hardcover');
    if (book && !book.querySelector('.hc-generated')) {
      var bl = book.querySelector('.user-items-list'); if (bl) bl.style.display = '';
    }
  }, 6000);
})();

        function setHeaderHeightVar() {
          document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
            '--header-height',
            header.getBoundingClientRect().height + 'px'
          );
        }
        setHeaderHeightVar();
        var images = header.getElementsByTagName('img');
        for (var i = 0; i < images.length; i++) {
          if (!images[i].complete) {
            images[i].addEventListener('load', setHeaderHeightVar);
          }
        }
      })();
      //# sourceURL=reserveSpaceForHeader.js
    </script>
  </header>

<script>
gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
/* === EDIT YOUR INTRO HEADING HERE === */
var PEEL_HEADING = "Just a Kid,<br>From Akron.";
/* ==================================== */
function initInvitationPeelReveal() {
  if (document.body.classList.contains("sqs-edit-mode-active")) return;
  var leftImg = document.querySelector('img[src*="peel-left"], img[alt*="peel-left"]');
  var rightImg = document.querySelector('img[src*="peel-right"], img[alt*="peel-right"]');
  if (!leftImg || !rightImg) return;
  var leftOriginal = leftImg.closest(".fe-block") || leftImg.closest(".sqs-block");
  var rightOriginal = rightImg.closest(".fe-block") || rightImg.closest(".sqs-block");
  var section = leftImg.closest(".page-section");
  if (!leftOriginal || !rightOriginal || !section) return;
  if (section.dataset.peelReady === "true") return;
  section.dataset.peelReady = "true";
  section.classList.add("peel-section");
  leftOriginal.classList.add("peel-original");
  rightOriginal.classList.add("peel-original");
  var wrapper = section.querySelector(".content-wrapper") || section;
  wrapper.classList.add("peel-pin");
  var leftFocal  = getComputedStyle(leftImg).objectPosition  || "center top";
  var rightFocal = getComputedStyle(rightImg).objectPosition || "center top";
  var stage = document.createElement("div");
  stage.className = "peel-stage";
  stage.innerHTML =
    '<div class="peel-panel peel-left-panel"><img src="' + (leftImg.currentSrc || leftImg.src) + '" alt=""></div>' +
    '<div class="peel-panel peel-right-panel"><img src="' + (rightImg.currentSrc || rightImg.src) + '" alt=""></div>' +
    '<div class="peel-content"><h2 class="peel-title">' + PEEL_HEADING + '</h2></div>';
  wrapper.appendChild(stage);
  var leftPanel  = stage.querySelector(".peel-left-panel");
  var rightPanel = stage.querySelector(".peel-right-panel");
  var content    = stage.querySelector(".peel-content");
  var title      = stage.querySelector(".peel-title");
  var panelImages = stage.querySelectorAll(".peel-panel img");
  leftPanel.querySelector("img").style.objectPosition  = leftFocal;
  rightPanel.querySelector("img").style.objectPosition = rightFocal;

  var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
  mm.add("(min-width: 768px)", function () {
    gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: section, start: "top top", end: "bottom bottom", scrub: 0.6, invalidateOnRefresh: true } })
      .to(leftPanel,  { xPercent: -101, rotationY: -26, ease: "power1.in" }, 0)
      .to(rightPanel, { xPercent:  101, rotationY:  26, ease: "power1.in" }, 0)
      /* heading stays visible and glides DOWN to sit under the reveal */
      .fromTo(content, { y: 0 }, { y: function () { return stage.clientHeight * 0.36; }, ease: "power1.out" }, 0)
      .fromTo(title,   { scale: 1 }, { scale: 0.74, ease: "power1.out" }, 0);
  });
  mm.add("(max-width: 767px)", function () {
    gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: section, start: "top top", end: "bottom bottom", scrub: 0.6, invalidateOnRefresh: true } })
      .to(leftPanel,  { yPercent: -101, rotationX:  24, ease: "power1.in" }, 0)
      .to(rightPanel, { yPercent:  101, rotationX: -24, ease: "power1.in" }, 0)
      .fromTo(content, { y: 0 }, { y: function () { return stage.clientHeight * 0.34; }, ease: "power1.out" }, 0)
      .fromTo(title,   { scale: 1 }, { scale: 0.82, ease: "power1.out" }, 0);
  });

  panelImages.forEach(function (img) {
    if (!img.complete) { img.addEventListener("load", peelRefresh, { once: true }); img.addEventListener("error", peelRefresh, { once: true }); }
  });
}
function peelRefresh() { if (window.ScrollTrigger) ScrollTrigger.refresh(); }
function buildAndRefresh() { initInvitationPeelReveal(); peelRefresh(); }
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { setTimeout(buildAndRefresh, 500); });
window.addEventListener("load", function () {
  buildAndRefresh();
  setTimeout(peelRefresh, 300); setTimeout(peelRefresh, 1200); setTimeout(peelRefresh, 2500);
});
if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) { document.fonts.ready.then(peelRefresh); }
window.addEventListener("orientationchange", function () { setTimeout(peelRefresh, 200); });
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){

  var section=document.querySelector('#list-reveal') || document.querySelector('[data-section-id="6a25f9074d2d1c1841b56b4c"]');
  if(!section) return;

  section.querySelectorAll(".rv-shatter,.rv-crack,.rv-hover-hint,.rv-touch-mark").forEach(function(el){
    el.remove();
  });

  section.querySelectorAll(".list-item-media").forEach(function(media){
    var img=media.querySelector("img");
    if(!img) return;

    var src =
      img.currentSrc ||
      img.getAttribute("data-image") ||
      img.getAttribute("data-src") ||
      img.src;

    if(!src) return;

    var wrap=document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className="rv-shatter";

    var moves=[
      ["-105px","-85px","-18deg"],["0px","-115px","12deg"],["105px","-82px","20deg"],
      ["-120px","0px","14deg"],["0px","-55px","-10deg"],["120px","0px","-16deg"],
      ["-95px","95px","-22deg"],["0px","120px","18deg"],["95px","95px","24deg"]
    ];

    for(var y=0;y<3;y++){
      for(var x=0;x<3;x++){
        var i=y*3+x;
        var shard=document.createElement("span");

        shard.className="rv-shard";
        shard.style.left=(x*33.333)+"%";
        shard.style.top=(y*33.333)+"%";
        shard.style.backgroundImage='url("'+src+'")';
        shard.style.backgroundPosition=(x*50)+"% "+(y*50)+"%";
        shard.style.setProperty("--tx",moves[i][0]);
        shard.style.setProperty("--ty",moves[i][1]);
        shard.style.setProperty("--r",moves[i][2]);

        wrap.appendChild(shard);
      }
    }

    media.appendChild(wrap);
  });

  section.querySelectorAll(".list-item").forEach(function(item){
    var touch=document.createElement("div");
    touch.className="rv-touch-mark";

    touch.innerHTML =
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">' +
        '<path d="M32 10c-11 0-20 9-20 20"/>' +
        '<path d="M52 30c0-11-9-20-20-20"/>' +
        '<path d="M17 43c-3.4-4.5-5-8.6-5-13"/>' +
        '<path d="M47 48c3.4-5.6 5-11.7 5-18"/>' +
        '<path d="M22 30c0-5.5 4.5-10 10-10s10 4.5 10 10"/>' +
        '<path d="M22 30c0 9.8-2.5 16.5-6.8 23"/>' +
        '<path d="M42 30c0 10.4-2.7 18.9-7.8 26"/>' +
        '<path d="M29 56c3.5-6.8 5-15 5-26"/>' +
        '<path d="M30 30c0-1.1.9-2 2-2s2 .9 2 2"/>' +
        '<path d="M28 43c-.7 4.5-2.1 8.5-4.2 12"/>' +
        '<path d="M38 42c-.6 4.4-1.8 8.5-3.6 12.5"/>' +
      '</svg>';

    item.appendChild(touch);
  });

  if(!window.matchMedia("(hover:none)").matches) return;

  section.querySelectorAll(".list-item").forEach(function(item){
    item.addEventListener("click",function(e){
      if(item.classList.contains("is-open") && e.target.closest("a")) return;
      e.preventDefault();

      section.querySelectorAll(".list-item.is-open").forEach(function(openItem){
        if(openItem!==item) openItem.classList.remove("is-open");
      });

      item.classList.toggle("is-open");
    });
  });

});

<script src="https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  /* ===== EDIT header text here ===== */
  var EYEBROW="Media Appearances", SYNOPSIS="From sit-downs to four decades of highlight reels, the moments that built the King, all in one place.",
      ROW_TITLE="Top 8 Highlights", ROW_HINT="The King on Screen";
  /* ================================= */

  function ytId(u){ if(!u) return null; var m=String(u).match(/(?:youtu\.be\/|[?&]v=|\/embed\/|\/shorts\/)([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})/); return m?m[1]:null; }
  function thumb(id){ return "https://i.ytimg.com/vi/"+id+"/maxresdefault.jpg"; }
  var PLAY='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>';
  var MUTED='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M11 5L6 9H3v6h3l5 4V5z"/><path d="M16 9l5 5M21 9l-5 5"/></svg>';
  var SOUND='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M11 5L6 9H3v6h3l5 4V5z"/><path d="M15.5 8.5a5 5 0 010 7"/></svg>';

  function inEditor(){
    /* The Squarespace editor renders the page in an iframe whose TOP url is /config.
       The live site (even the logged-in preview) has a top url of the real page, not /config. */
    if(document.body.classList.contains("sqs-edit-mode-active")) return true;
    try{ if(String(window.top.location.pathname).indexOf("/config")===0) return true; }catch(e){}
    return false;
  }
  function build(){
    if(inEditor()) return;
    if(document.querySelector(".mn")) return;

    var anchors=document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="youtu.be"], a[href*="youtube.com"]');
    var seen=[], items=[];
    anchors.forEach(function(a){
      var li=a.closest('.list-item, .user-items-list-item-container, li'); if(!li||seen.indexOf(li)>-1) return;
      var id=ytId(a.getAttribute("href")); if(!id) return; seen.push(li);
      var t=li.querySelector('.list-item-content__title, h1,h2,h3,h4');
      var d=li.querySelector('.list-item-content__description, p');
      var im=li.querySelector('.list-item-media img, img');
      items.push({id:id,t:(t?t.textContent:"").trim()||"Watch",by:(d?d.textContent:"").trim(),img:(im&&im.src)?im.src:thumb(id)});
    });
    if(!items.length) return;

    var firstLi=seen[0];
    var section=firstLi.closest(".page-section")||firstLi.closest("section")||firstLi.parentElement;
    var listRoot=firstLi.closest(".user-items-list-section, .user-items-list, .sqs-block-content")||firstLi.parentElement;
    section.classList.add("mn-host"); listRoot.classList.add("mn-source");
    var feature=items[0];

    var wrap=document.createElement("div"); wrap.className="mn";
    wrap.innerHTML=
      '<section class="mn-bb">'+
        '<div class="mn-bb__media"><div class="mn-bb__poster" style="background-image:url(\''+feature.img+'\')"></div><div class="mn-bb__video" id="mnHero"></div></div>'+
        '<div class="mn-bb__guard"></div>'+
        '<button class="mn-mute" id="mnMute" aria-label="Toggle sound">'+MUTED+'</button>'+
        '<div class="mn-bb__in"><span class="mn-bb__eye">'+EYEBROW+'</span><h2 class="mn-bb__title">'+feature.t+'</h2>'+
          '<div class="mn-bb__meta"><span class="tag">FEATURED</span>'+(feature.by?'<span>'+feature.by+'</span>':'')+'<span>•</span><span>HD</span></div>'+
          '<p class="mn-bb__desc">'+SYNOPSIS+'</p>'+
          '<div class="mn-bb__cta"><button class="mn-btn mn-btn--play" data-mn-play>'+PLAY+' Play Feature</button>'+
          '<button class="mn-btn mn-btn--info" data-mn-scroll><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v5M12 7.5v.5"/></svg> Browse All</button></div>'+
        '</div></section>'+
      '<div class="mn-rows"><section class="mn-row"><div class="mn-row__head"><h3 class="mn-row__title">'+ROW_TITLE+'</h3><span class="mn-row__hint">'+ROW_HINT+'</span></div>'+
        '<div class="mn-rail"><button class="mn-arrow mn-arrow--l is-hidden"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button>'+
          '<div class="mn-track"></div>'+
          '<button class="mn-arrow mn-arrow--r"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button>'+
        '</div></section></div>';
    section.appendChild(wrap);   /* attach to the SECTION (full width), not the content-wrapper */

    /* cards */
    var track=wrap.querySelector(".mn-track");
    items.forEach(function(v,i){
      var card=document.createElement("div"); card.className="mn-card";
      card.innerHTML='<span class="mn-rank">'+(i+1)+'</span><div class="mn-thumb"><img alt="" src="'+v.img+'"><div class="mn-grad"></div><div class="mn-pl">'+PLAY+'</div>'+
        '<div class="mn-cap"><p class="mn-cap__t">'+v.t+'</p>'+(v.by?'<span class="mn-cap__by">'+v.by+'</span>':'')+'</div></div>';
      var img=card.querySelector("img"); img.onerror=function(){ img.onerror=null; img.src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/"+v.id+"/hqdefault.jpg"; };
      card.addEventListener("click",function(){ openLB(v); });
      track.appendChild(card);
    });
    var aL=wrap.querySelector(".mn-arrow--l"), aR=wrap.querySelector(".mn-arrow--r");
    aL.addEventListener("click",function(){ track.scrollBy({left:-track.clientWidth*0.8,behavior:"smooth"}); });
    aR.addEventListener("click",function(){ track.scrollBy({left:track.clientWidth*0.8,behavior:"smooth"}); });
    function arrows(){ aL.classList.toggle("is-hidden", track.scrollLeft<8);
      aR.classList.toggle("is-hidden", track.scrollLeft >= track.scrollWidth-track.clientWidth-8); }
    track.addEventListener("scroll",arrows); setTimeout(arrows,300);

    /* lightbox on body */
    var lb=document.createElement("div"); lb.className="mn-lb";
    lb.innerHTML='<div class="mn-lb__box"><div class="mn-lb__frame"></div><div class="mn-lb__bar"><div><h4 class="mn-lb__t"></h4><div class="mn-lb__by"></div></div>'+
      '<button class="mn-lb__x"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button></div></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(lb);
    var frame=lb.querySelector(".mn-lb__frame");
    function openLB(v){ if(hero&&hero.pauseVideo) hero.pauseVideo();
      frame.innerHTML='<iframe allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; fullscreen" allowfullscreen src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/'+v.id+'?autoplay=1&rel=0&modestbranding=1"></iframe>';
      lb.querySelector(".mn-lb__t").textContent=v.t; lb.querySelector(".mn-lb__by").textContent=v.by;
      lb.classList.add("open"); requestAnimationFrame(function(){ lb.classList.add("show"); }); document.body.style.overflow="hidden"; }
    function closeLB(){ lb.classList.remove("show"); setTimeout(function(){ lb.classList.remove("open"); frame.innerHTML=""; document.body.style.overflow="";
      if(hero&&hero.playVideo) hero.playVideo(); },250); }
    lb.querySelector(".mn-lb__x").addEventListener("click",closeLB);
    lb.addEventListener("click",function(e){ if(e.target===lb) closeLB(); });
    document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){ if(e.key==="Escape") closeLB(); });
    wrap.querySelector("[data-mn-play]").addEventListener("click",function(){ openLB(feature); });
    wrap.querySelector("[data-mn-scroll]").addEventListener("click",function(){ wrap.querySelector(".mn-rows").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"}); });

    /* hero autoplay (muted, looped via API so no playlist chrome) */
    var hero=null, muted=true;
    function startHero(){
      hero=new YT.Player("mnHero",{ videoId:feature.id,
        playerVars:{autoplay:1,mute:1,controls:0,rel:0,modestbranding:1,playsinline:1,disablekb:1,fs:0,iv_load_policy:3},
        events:{ onReady:function(e){ e.target.mute(); e.target.playVideo(); document.getElementById("mnHero").classList.add("on"); },
                 onStateChange:function(e){ if(e.data===YT.PlayerState.ENDED){ e.target.seekTo(0); e.target.playVideo(); } } } });
    }
    if(window.YT && YT.Player) startHero();
    else { var p=window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady; window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady=function(){ if(p)p(); startHero(); }; }
    var mb=wrap.querySelector("#mnMute");
    mb.addEventListener("click",function(){ if(!hero) return; muted=!muted;
      if(muted){ hero.mute(); mb.innerHTML=MUTED; } else { hero.unMute(); hero.setVolume(60); mb.innerHTML=SOUND; } });
  }

  window.addEventListener("load", function(){ setTimeout(build,600); });
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){ setTimeout(build,900); });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  /* transparent header only while the hero is under it; revert on the sections below */
  function update(){
    var hero = document.querySelector('.mn');
    if(!hero){ document.body.classList.remove('mn-hero-top'); return; }
    document.body.classList.toggle('mn-hero-top', hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 120);
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive:true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', update);
  window.addEventListener('load', function(){ setTimeout(update,500); setTimeout(update,1400); });
  setTimeout(update, 800);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var pl=document.getElementById("pre-loader"); if(!pl) return;
  var start=Date.now();
  function out(){ pl.classList.add("pl-out"); setTimeout(function(){ pl.style.display="none"; }, 800); }
  window.addEventListener("load", function(){ setTimeout(out, Math.max(0, 600-(Date.now()-start))); });
  setTimeout(out, 2500);
})();

<script>
(function () {
  const SECTION_SELECTOR = "#hardcover";
  function clamp(v,min,max){ return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }
  function cleanText(t){ return (t||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim(); }
  function ease(t){ return t<0.5 ? 2*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2; }
  function upgradeImage(url){
    if(!url) return "";
    if(!url.includes("images.squarespace-cdn.com")) return url;
    url=url.replace(/[?&]format=\d+w/g,"");
    return url + (url.includes("?")?"&":"?") + "format=2500w";
  }
  function getImageUrl(item){
    const img=item.querySelector("img"); if(!img) return "";
    return upgradeImage(img.getAttribute("data-image")||img.getAttribute("data-src")||img.currentSrc||img.src||"");
  }
  function titleElement(section){
    const els=section.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,[class*="title"]');
    for(let i=0;i<els.length;i++){ const el=els[i];
      if(el.closest(".list-item")||el.closest(".hc-generated")) continue;
      if(cleanText(el.textContent)) return el;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function descriptionText(section){
    const els=section.querySelectorAll('[class*="description"], .sqsrte p, p');
    for(let i=0;i<els.length;i++){ const el=els[i];
      if(el.closest(".list-item")||el.closest(".hc-generated")) continue;
      const t=cleanText(el.textContent); if(t) return t;
    }
    return "";
  }
  function getCards(section){
    return Array.from(section.querySelectorAll(".user-items-list-item-container > .list-item")).map(function(item){
      return {
        title: cleanText(item.querySelector(".list-item-content__title")?.textContent) || "",
        description: cleanText(item.querySelector(".list-item-content__description")?.textContent) || "",
        image: getImageUrl(item)
      };
    }).filter(function(c){ return c.image; });
  }
  function pageMarkup(cls){
    return `<article class="hc-page ${cls}"><div class="hc-image"><img alt=""></div>
      <div class="hc-text"><h3 class="hc-title"></h3><div class="hc-description"></div></div></article>`;
  }
  function turnFaceMarkup(cls){
    return `<div class="hc-turn-face ${cls}"><div class="hc-image"><img alt=""></div>
      <div class="hc-text"><h3 class="hc-title"></h3><div class="hc-description"></div></div></div>`;
  }
  function setPage(page, card){
    if(!page||!card) return;
    const img=page.querySelector("img"), title=page.querySelector(".hc-title"), desc=page.querySelector(".hc-description");
    if(img){ img.src=card.image; img.alt=card.title; }
    if(title) title.textContent=card.title;
    if(desc) desc.textContent=card.description;
  }
  function build(section, cards, spreads, heading, note){
    const old=section.querySelector(".hc-generated"); if(old) old.remove();
    const html = `
      <div class="hc-generated">
        <div class="hc-copy">
          <h2 class="hc-heading">${heading}</h2>
          <div class="hc-note">${note}</div>
          <div class="hc-progress">
            ${Array.from({length:spreads}).map(function(_,i){ return `<span class="hc-dot ${i===0?"is-active":""}"></span>`; }).join("")}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="hc-stage">
          <div class="hc-book">
            <div class="hc-spread">${pageMarkup("hc-left")}${pageMarkup("hc-right")}</div>
            <article class="hc-turning-page">${turnFaceMarkup("hc-turn-front")}${turnFaceMarkup("hc-turn-back")}</article>
            <div class="hc-spine"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    const content=section.querySelector(".content")||section;
    content.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", html);
    return section.querySelector(".hc-generated");
  }
  function initHardcover(){
    const section=document.querySelector(SECTION_SELECTOR); if(!section) return false;
    const cards=getCards(section); if(cards.length<2) return false;
    section.classList.add("hardcover-ready");

    const titleEl = titleElement(section);
    const heading = titleEl ? cleanText(titleEl.textContent) : "Meet the team";
    const note = descriptionText(section) || "Scroll to open the book.";

    const L=cards.length;
    const spreads=Math.ceil(L/2);
    const flips=Math.max(spreads-1,1);
    section.style.setProperty("--hardcover-scroll-height", `calc(100vh + ${flips*80}vh)`, "important");

    const c=build(section, cards, spreads, heading, note);
    const headingNode=c.querySelector(".hc-heading");
    const leftPage=c.querySelector(".hc-left"), rightPage=c.querySelector(".hc-right");
    const turningPage=c.querySelector(".hc-turning-page");
    const turnFront=c.querySelector(".hc-turn-front"), turnBack=c.querySelector(".hc-turn-back");
    const dots=Array.from(c.querySelectorAll(".hc-dot"));
    const at=function(i){ return cards[clamp(i,0,L-1)]; };

    function syncHeadingSize(){
      if(!titleEl||!headingNode) return;
      const cs=getComputedStyle(titleEl);
      if(cs.fontSize && cs.fontSize!=="0px") headingNode.style.fontSize=cs.fontSize;
      if(cs.lineHeight && cs.lineHeight!=="normal") headingNode.style.lineHeight=cs.lineHeight;
    }
    syncHeadingSize();

    function draw(exact){
      exact=clamp(exact,0,flips);
      const s=Math.min(flips-1, Math.floor(exact));
      const local=exact - s;
      setPage(leftPage,  at(2*s));
      setPage(rightPage, at(2*s+3));
      setPage(turnFront, at(2*s+1));
      setPage(turnBack,  at(2*s+2));
      if(exact>=flips){
        setPage(leftPage, at(2*flips));
        setPage(rightPage, at(2*flips+1));
        turningPage.style.opacity="0";
        turningPage.style.transform="rotateY(-180deg)";
      } else {
        turningPage.style.opacity="1";
        turningPage.style.transform=`rotateY(${-ease(local)*180}deg)`;
      }
      const active=clamp(Math.round(exact),0,spreads-1);
      dots.forEach(function(d,i){ d.classList.toggle("is-active", i===active); });
    }
    function update(){
      const rect=section.getBoundingClientRect();
      const travel=Math.max(rect.height - window.innerHeight, 1);
      const progress=clamp(-rect.top/travel,0,1);
      draw(progress*flips);
    }
    update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, {passive:true});
    window.addEventListener("resize", function(){ syncHeadingSize(); update(); });
    return true;
  }
  let tries=0;
  const timer=setInterval(function(){ tries++; if(initHardcover()||tries>30) clearInterval(timer); }, 300);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
var SECTION_ID="novule-story";
function extract(sec){
  var items=[].slice.call(sec.querySelectorAll(".list-item, .user-items-list-item-container"));
  var seen={},data=[];
  items.forEach(function(L){
    var img=L.querySelector(".list-item-media img, img");
    var src=img?(img.getAttribute("data-src")||img.getAttribute("data-image")||img.currentSrc||img.src):"";
    var t=L.querySelector(".list-item-content__title, h1,h2,h3,h4");
    var d=L.querySelector(".list-item-content__description, p");
    var b=L.querySelector(".list-item-content__button, .list-item-content__button-inner, a[class*='button']");
    var raw=(t?t.textContent:"").trim(), yr=raw, ev="";
    var di=-1, dc="";
    var k1=raw.indexOf("—"); if(k1>-1){di=k1;dc="—";}
    var k2=raw.indexOf("–"); if(k2>-1&&(di<0||k2<di)){di=k2;dc="–";}
    if(di<0){ var k3=raw.indexOf(" - "); if(k3>-1){di=k3;dc=" - ";} }
    if(di>-1){ yr=raw.slice(0,di).trim(); ev=raw.slice(di+dc.length).trim(); }
    var p=(d?d.textContent:"").trim(), loc=b?b.textContent.trim():"";
    var key=yr+"|"+ev+"|"+p+"|"+src; if(seen[key])return; seen[key]=1;
    data.push({img:src,yr:yr,ev:ev,loc:loc,p:p});
  });
  if(items[0]){ var lr=items[0].closest(".user-items-list-section,.user-items-list,.sqs-block-content")||items[0].parentElement; lr.classList.add("st-src"); }
  return data;
}
function build(){ var sec=document.getElementById(SECTION_ID); if(!sec||sec.querySelector("[data-st-built]"))return; var data=extract(sec); if(!data.length)return;
var wrap=document.createElement('div'); wrap.setAttribute('data-st-built','1'); wrap.className='st'; wrap.innerHTML='<div class="st-track"></div>'; sec.appendChild(wrap);
var tr=wrap.querySelector('.st-track');
tr.innerHTML=data.map(function(x){ return '<div class="st-panel"><div class="st-yr">'+x.yr+'</div><div class="ph">'+(x.img?'<img src="'+x.img+'" alt="">':'')+'</div><div class="st-ev">'+x.ev+'</div>'+(x.loc?'<div class="st-loc">'+x.loc+'</div>':'')+'<p class="st-p">'+x.p+'</p></div>'; }).join('');
var dn=false,sx=0,sl=0; tr.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){dn=true;tr.classList.add('drag');sx=e.pageX;sl=tr.scrollLeft;}); window.addEventListener('mouseup',function(){dn=false;tr.classList.remove('drag');}); window.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){if(!dn)return;tr.scrollLeft=sl-(e.pageX-sx);});
}
function boot(){ try{ build(); }catch(e){} }
if(document.readyState!=="loading") setTimeout(boot,150);
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){setTimeout(boot,150);});
window.addEventListener("load",function(){setTimeout(boot,150);});
window.addEventListener("mercury:load",function(){setTimeout(boot,150);});
})();
</script>

Hidden transactions can be reopened and restored whenever necessary.</p></div></div></nav></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-cli w-dyn-item"><div data-delay="200" data-hover="false" data-w-id="e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de244" class="faq-dropdown_wrap w-dropdown"><div data-wf-native-id-path="c2e63c00-6ea5-1743-40ca-d96384caaf2c:9d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbac4_instance-5:e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de245_instance-5" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de245" data-wf-cms-context="%5B%7B%22collectionId%22%3A%2269e4bd79f63ac5ac24d64da0%22%2C%22itemId%22%3A%226a01daac9481ea764c8f9061%22%7D%5D" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%229d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbaba%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22c2e63c00-6ea5-1743-40ca-d96384caaf2c%22%7D%2C%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de244%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%229d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbac4%22%7D%5D" class="faq-dropdown_toggle w-dropdown-toggle"><div class="heading-style-h6 for-drpdwn">Why aren&#x27;t transactions syncing from my connected account?</div><div class="dropdown-icon_wrap"><div class="dropdown-line first"></div><div class="dropdown-line second"></div></div></div><nav class="faq-dropdown_nav w-dropdown-list"><div class="faq-dropdown-cont"><div class="faq-cont-rt w-richtext"><p>Transactions from some banks may not be processed on weekends. As a result these transactions will appear in your account on Mondays.</p></div></div></nav></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-cli w-dyn-item"><div data-delay="200" data-hover="false" data-w-id="e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de244" class="faq-dropdown_wrap w-dropdown"><div data-wf-native-id-path="c2e63c00-6ea5-1743-40ca-d96384caaf2c:9d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbac4_instance-6:e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de245_instance-6" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de245" data-wf-cms-context="%5B%7B%22collectionId%22%3A%2269e4bd79f63ac5ac24d64da0%22%2C%22itemId%22%3A%226a01daac44ed4341c67884b8%22%7D%5D" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%229d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbaba%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22c2e63c00-6ea5-1743-40ca-d96384caaf2c%22%7D%2C%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de244%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%229d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbac4%22%7D%5D" class="faq-dropdown_toggle w-dropdown-toggle"><div class="heading-style-h6 for-drpdwn">Can I sync savings accounts or credit cards?</div><div class="dropdown-icon_wrap"><div class="dropdown-line first"></div><div class="dropdown-line second"></div></div></div><nav class="faq-dropdown_nav w-dropdown-list"><div class="faq-dropdown-cont"><div class="faq-cont-rt w-richtext"><p>In the EU, savings accounts and credit cards cannot be linked due to regulatory restrictions. Alternatively, you can manually enter your data or save time with our Intelligent Import feature. <strong>Intelligent Import is available with Import Credits</strong>, which you can purchase whenever you need them. In the USA and Canada, these account types can be connected automatically.</p></div></div></nav></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-cli w-dyn-item"><div data-delay="200" data-hover="false" data-w-id="e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de244" class="faq-dropdown_wrap w-dropdown"><div data-wf-native-id-path="c2e63c00-6ea5-1743-40ca-d96384caaf2c:9d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbac4_instance-7:e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de245_instance-7" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de245" data-wf-cms-context="%5B%7B%22collectionId%22%3A%2269e4bd79f63ac5ac24d64da0%22%2C%22itemId%22%3A%226a01daaafb82e34055da431c%22%7D%5D" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%229d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbaba%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22c2e63c00-6ea5-1743-40ca-d96384caaf2c%22%7D%2C%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de244%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%229d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbac4%22%7D%5D" class="faq-dropdown_toggle w-dropdown-toggle"><div class="heading-style-h6 for-drpdwn">How can I set up recurring transactions?</div><div class="dropdown-icon_wrap"><div class="dropdown-line first"></div><div class="dropdown-line second"></div></div></div><nav class="faq-dropdown_nav w-dropdown-list"><div class="faq-dropdown-cont"><div class="faq-cont-rt w-richtext"><p>To create recurring transactions, navigate to the details screen of the transaction and use the &quot;Make Recurring&quot; feature. For transactions from synced financial accounts, simply mark them as recurring, and the application will handle tracking automatically.</p></div></div></nav></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq-cli w-dyn-item"><div data-delay="200" data-hover="false" data-w-id="e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de244" class="faq-dropdown_wrap w-dropdown"><div data-wf-native-id-path="c2e63c00-6ea5-1743-40ca-d96384caaf2c:9d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbac4_instance-8:e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de245_instance-8" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de245" data-wf-cms-context="%5B%7B%22collectionId%22%3A%2269e4bd79f63ac5ac24d64da0%22%2C%22itemId%22%3A%226a01daaa231abbf87ef294bb%22%7D%5D" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%229d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbaba%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22c2e63c00-6ea5-1743-40ca-d96384caaf2c%22%7D%2C%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22e0d7fb7b-bacc-970c-3384-8d34109de244%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%229d2ca833-73b2-4ecc-c4b6-5d4dc37dbac4%22%7D%5D" class="faq-dropdown_toggle w-dropdown-toggle"><div class="heading-style-h6 for-drpdwn">How does the Grassfeld app work?</div><div class="dropdown-icon_wrap"><div class="dropdown-line first"></div><div class="dropdown-line second"></div></div></div><nav class="faq-dropdown_nav w-dropdown-list"><div class="faq-dropdown-cont"><div class="faq-cont-rt w-richtext"><p>The Grassfeld app provides you insights into your actual and future financial situation by retrieving and categorizing your (bank) transactions as well as keeping track of your budgets and saving goals. <script>
	// Check selection
  document.getElementById('cw-cookie-icon').addEventListener('click', function() {
  	setConsentCheckboxes();
    hideOptions();
  	document.getElementById('cw-cookie-banner').style.display = 'flex';
  })
  
  // Hide Cookie Banner
  function hideBanner() {
    document.getElementById('cw-cookie-banner').style.display = 'none';
  }
  
  // Hide more options
  function hideOptions() {
  	document.getElementById('cw-cookie-options').style.height = '0px';
  }
	
  // If consentMode has not been set, show Cookie Banner
  if(localStorage.getItem('consentMode') === null) {
  	document.getElementById('cw-cookie-banner').style.display = 'flex';
  }
  
  //Logic to populate the preferences
  function setConsentCheckboxes() {
  	uncheckAllConsentCheckboxes();
  	
    const consentModeString = localStorage.getItem('consentMode');

  	if (consentModeString) {
    	const consentMode = JSON.parse(consentModeString);
      
        const consentMapping = {
          'functionality_storage': 'consent-necessary',
          'ad_storage': 'consent-ad-marketing',
          'analytics_storage': 'consent-analytics',
          'ad_user_data': 'consent-ad-user',
          'ad_personalization': 'consent-ad-personalization',
          'personalization_storage': 'consent-personalization',
          'security_storage': 'consent-security',
        };

        Object.entries(consentMapping).forEach(([storageKey, checkboxId]) => {
          const checkbox = document.getElementById(checkboxId);

         if (checkbox) {
            const isChecked = consentMode[storageKey] === 'granted';
            checkbox.checked = isChecked;

            const checkboxDiv = checkbox.previousElementSibling;
            if (checkboxDiv) {
              if (isChecked) {
                checkboxDiv.classList.add('w--redirected-checked');
              } else {
                checkboxDiv.classList.remove('w--redirected-checked');
              }
            }
          }
    	});
  	}
	}
  
  //Logic to uncheck all checkboxes
  function uncheckAllConsentCheckboxes() {
  	['consent-analytics', 'consent-ad-personalization', 'consent-ad-marketing', 'consent-ad-user', 'consent-personalization', 'consent-security'].forEach(checkboxId => {
    	const checkbox = document.getElementById(checkboxId);
    	if (checkbox) {
      checkbox.checked = false;
      
        const checkboxDiv = checkbox.previousElementSibling;
        if (checkboxDiv && checkboxDiv.classList.contains('w--redirected-checked')) {
          checkboxDiv.classList.remove('w--redirected-checked');
        }
    	}	
  	});
	}

  // Logic to update the preferences
  document.getElementById('cw-btn-accept-all').addEventListener('click', function() {
    setConsent({
      necessary: true,
      analytics: true,
      adpersonalized: true,
      admarketing: true,
      aduser: true,
      personalized: true,
      security: true,
    });
    hideBanner();
  });

  document.getElementById('cw-btn-accept-some').addEventListener('click', function() {
    setConsent({
      necessary: true,
      analytics: document.getElementById('consent-analytics').checked,
      adpersonalized: document.getElementById('consent-ad-personalization').checked,
      admarketing: document.getElementById('consent-ad-marketing').checked,
      aduser: document.getElementById('consent-ad-user').checked,
      personalized: document.getElementById('consent-personalization').checked,
      security: document.getElementById('consent-security').checked,
    });
    hideBanner();
  });

  document.getElementById('cw-btn-reject-all').addEventListener('click', function() {
    setConsent({
      necessary: true,
      analytics: false,
      adpersonalized: false,
      admarketing: false,
      aduser: false,
      personalized: false,
      security: false
    });
    hideBanner();
  }); 
  
  // Map the preferences to Google Consent Mode 
  function setConsent(consent) {
    const consentMode = {
      'functionality_storage': consent.necessary ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      'ad_user_data': consent.aduser ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      'ad_storage': consent.admarketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      'analytics_storage': consent.analytics ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      'ad_personalization': consent.adpersonalized ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      'personalization_storage': consent.personalized ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      'security_storage': consent.security ? 'granted' : 'denied',
    };
    gtag('consent', 'update', consentMode);  
    localStorage.setItem('consentMode', JSON.stringify(consentMode));
  }

<script>
  // Body lock scroll on mobile
  // Detecting if it is an iOS device, true/false
  var iOS = !!navigator.platform && /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.platform);

  $(document).ready(function () {
    // Defining that "overlay" is the element that has a changing display value
    var overlay = document.querySelector('.w-nav-overlay');

    // Creating our mutation observer, which we attach to overlay later
    var observer = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
      mutations.forEach(function (mutationRecord) {
        // Checking if it's the style attribute got changed and if display value now set to 'none'?
        if (mutationRecord.attributeName === 'style' && window.getComputedStyle(overlay).getPropertyValue('display') !== 'none') {
          //Overlay's  display value is no longer 'none', now changing the "body" styles:
          if (iOS) {
            // for iOS devices:
            var x = $(window).scrollTop().toFixed();

            $('body').css({ overflow: 'hidden', position: 'fixed', top: '-' + x + 'px', width: '100vw' });
          }
          // for all other devices:
          $('body').css('overflow', 'hidden');
        }
        //Overlay's  display value back to 'none' , now changing the "body" styles again:
        else {
          if (iOS) {
            //  for iOS devices:
            var t = $('body').css('top').replace('-', '').replace('px', '');
            $('body').css({ overflow: 'auto', position: '', width: '100vw' });
            $('body').animate({ scrollTop: t }, 0);
          }
          // for all other devices:
          $('body').css('overflow', '');
        }
      });
    });
    // Attach the mutation observer to overlay, and only when attribute values change
    observer.observe(overlay, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
  });
</script>

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // Function to set display style for elements based on their class
    function setDisplayStyle(className, displayStyle) {
      var elements = document.querySelectorAll('.' + className);

        element.style.display = displayStyle;
      });
    }

    // Detect iOS devices
    var isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent);

    console.log('Screen Width: ', screenWidth);
    console.log('isIOS: ', isIOS);

    if (screenWidth > 900) {
      // Show both iOS and Android elements if screen width is greater than 900px
      setDisplayStyle('ios-element', 'block');
      setDisplayStyle('android-element', 'block');
    } else {
      if (isIOS) {
        // Show iOS elements and hide Android elements if it's an iOS device
        setDisplayStyle('ios-element', 'block');
        setDisplayStyle('android-element', 'none');
      } else {
        // Show Android elements and hide iOS elements if it's not an iOS device
        setDisplayStyle('android-element', 'block');
        setDisplayStyle('ios-element', 'none');
      }
    }

    // Optionally hide the download button if not iOS (as per your initial script)
    if (!isIOS) {
      console.log('Not iOS, hiding download button');
      // Example using jQuery (ensure jQuery is included in your project)
      $(document).ready(function () {
        $('.download-now-button').css('visibility', 'hidden');
      });
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
  function setCookie(name, value, hours) {
    var date = new Date();
    date.setTime(date.getTime() + hours * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    document.cookie = name + '=' + value + ';expires=' + date.toUTCString() + ';path=/';
  }

  function getCookie(name) {
    var match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)'));
    return match ? match[2] : null;
  }

  function handleBanner() {
    var banner = document.getElementById('banner2_component');
    if (!banner) return;

    var isVisible = window.innerWidth <= 425 && !getCookie('bannerShown');

    if (isVisible) {
      banner.style.display = 'block';
      document.body.style.setProperty('padding-top', banner.offsetHeight + 'px', 'important');
    } else {
      banner.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.style.setProperty('padding-top', '0', 'important');
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    handleBanner();

    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('banner2_close-button');
    if (closeBtn) {
      closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setCookie('bannerShown', 'true', 1);
        handleBanner();
      });
    }

    // Copyright year auto-update
    var year = new Date().getFullYear();
    document.querySelectorAll('[data="year"]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.textContent = year;
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', handleBanner);
</script>


<script type="text/javascript">
  //Update link to application with URL Parameters
  window.onload = function () {
    // 1. Select all links that contain your specific domain
    // This works for "navigator.grassfeld.com/auth/welcome", "navigator.grassfeld.com/login", etc.
    const grassfeldLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="navigator.grassfeld.com"]');

    // 2. Loop through each found button/link and run the update function
    grassfeldLinks.forEach(function (btn) {
      appendUtmsToButton(btn);
    });
  };

  function appendUtmsToButton(button) {
    // Safety check: ensure button exists and has a valid href
    if (!button || !button.href) return;

    try {
      // 1. Get the UTMs from the current browser address bar
      const currentParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

      // If there are no parameters in the window, we don't need to do anything
      if (Array.from(currentParams).length === 0) return;

      // 2. Parse the target button's URL
      // (button.href automatically returns the full absolute URL)
      const targetUrl = new URL(button.href);

      // 3. Append the current params to the target URL's existing params
      // using .searchParams (a built-in helper for the URL object)
      currentParams.forEach(function (value, key) {
        // .append adds them safely, even if parameters already exist
        targetUrl.searchParams.append(key, value);
      });

      // 4. Update the button with the new full URL string
      button.href = targetUrl.toString();

      // Debugging: View the change in your console
      // console.log("Updated Link:", button.href);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating URL for button:', button, error);
    }
  }
</script><script src="https://Excited.code.anton-atom.com/Grassfeld/home_explore-smart-features.js"></script>
